opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: up to £500,000; occasionally up to £750,000 in special cases; most grants below £300,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based organisations and institutions; not open to individuals without formal employment/contractual relationship with the hosting institution, unaffiliated individuals, schools or FE colleges, undergraduate/master's students, or projects led by non-UK organisations (exceptional cases possible).
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Foundation's five interconnected priorities and aim to improve lives in the UK. Two application deadlines a year (spring and autumn).

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants from diverse backgrounds encouraged, particularly from individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities; partnership applications encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Research funding to understand the barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society, focused on racial diversity within the UK. 2026 priority theme: inter-generational changes, continuities and challenges in racially diverse UK.

opportunities.title: Strategic Fund

amount.raw: Up to £15 million available; major grants typically in the range of £1-3 million each

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based organisations; not open to individuals without formal employment/relationship with the hosting institution, unaffiliated individuals, undergraduate/master's students, or PhD fee support.
opportunities.summary: Research grants for original and ambitious projects that confront the scale and urgency of the UK's biggest social and economic challenges, responding to one or more of the five priority questions. Multidisciplinary and innovative approaches encouraged.
